15 Indian tourists die in Vietnam boat accident

A speedboat carrying Indian tourists capsized off the coast of Vietnam's Phú Quốc island, resulting in the deaths of 15 individuals. Reports indicate that 21 people were rescued from the incident, which occurred in rough seas. Prime Minister Narendra Modi expressed condolences and assured assistance to the affected families.
